configurations.name: web
runtimeArgs: lsof -ti tcp:3002 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null && { echo 'port 3002 is busy: reuse that server, or free it with clean-dev-ports'; exit 1; }; log="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.qa/web.log"; mkdir -p "${log%/*}"; exec > >(tee "$log") 2>&1; WATCHPACK_POLLING=true exec pnpm --filter @heliogrid/web dev

configurations.name: clean-dev-ports
runtimeArgs: for port in 3002 8084 8081 3100; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$port -sTCP:LISTEN); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "port $port: stopping $pids"; kill $pids; else echo "port $port: free"; fi; done

configurations.name: android-emulator
runtimeArgs: prev=''; restore() { if [ "$prev" = null ] || [ -z "$prev" ]; then adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings delete secure stylus_handwriting_enabled; else adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings put secure stylus_handwriting_enabled "$prev"; fi; adb -s emulator-5554 emu kill; }; trap restore EXIT; emulator -avd Pixel_8_API_36 -cores 2 -memory 4096 -gpu host & pid=$!; adb -s emulator-5554 wait-for-device; until [ "$(adb -s emulator-5554 shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = 1 ]; do sleep 2; done; prev=$(adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings get secure stylus_handwriting_enabled | tr -d '\r'); echo "stylus_handwriting_enabled was $prev; off for this run"; adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings put secure stylus_handwriting_enabled 0; adb -s emulator-5554 shell am force-stop com.google.android.inputmethod.latin; adb -s emulator-5554 reverse tcp:9000 tcp:9000; echo 'emulator up: Gboard stylus handwriting off, port 9000 reversed'; wait $pid
